title: Structured producer brief
summary: Community hypothesis: prioritize musical identity, groove, instrument roles, performance, development, mix relationships and constraints instead of a long tag list. Requires controlled tests.

build.target: Create a prioritized, testable musical production brief from a listener's request instead of accumulating unrelated genre adjectives.
requires: Suno model and input mode known before execution
Suno MCP authorization and credit budget only if generating audio
outputs: Optionally a generated song receipt and listening evaluation
execute: Extract the desired identity, groove, instrument roles, performance, arrangement arc and mix constraints.
Rank at most three nonnegotiable musical properties; leave unresolved choices visible.
Draft a concise Simple description or Custom style/lyrics consistent with the model's tool contract.
If authorized, generate and compare against a shorter neutral baseline without changing unrelated controls.
Record whether the resulting audio audibly satisfies the top priorities and what failed.

applies_when: A song needs a coherent identity, rhythm and evolving arrangement.
A prompt with too many adjectives has yielded generic or conflicting output.
avoid_when: The user's precise melody already exists as MIDI; prefer the MIDI conditioning build.
The prompt would imitate a protected recording or lacks permission.

operator: Do not generate without approved credit budget and account grant.
Community heuristics are hypotheses; do not report a universal optimization.

stop_when: A brief and its ranking are recorded, or missing requirements prevent it.
Generation attempt ends at authorized candidate count or a documented provider error.

checks: Inspect model, prompt/controls, all candidate clip IDs and blind listening outcome.
Compare measured or heard differences against a predeclared baseline.
